title: Sickle cell variants, hemolytic and aplastic anemia, hemophilia, neutropenia
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM code for the patient's blood disorder (only that code).
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for hemophilia A.

HPI
The patient is a 69-year-old male who presents today for a scheduled follow-up regarding his hemophilia A. He reports that he has been adherent to his prophylactic factor VIII deficiency management regimen. He reports that his joint mobility remains stable and he has not experienced any significant issues with his current treatment schedule. He notes that the prophylactic factor infusions are effective in maintaining his baseline status. He denies any new concerns regarding his mobility or coagulopathy.

Medication List
- Factor VIII concentrate (prophylactic infusions)

Exam
The patient appears well-nourished and is in no acute distress. He is alert and oriented x3. Physical examination of the upper and lower extremities reveals no joint swelling, erythema, or decreased range of motion. Skin is intact without bruising.

Assessment
1. Hemophilia A (hereditary factor VIII deficiency). The patient is currently stable on his prophylactic factor infusions.

Plan
1. Continue current prophylactic factor VIII deficiency infusions as prescribed.
2. Follow up in the clinic in six months for routine monitoring.

Electronically signed,
P. O'Brien, MD
May 14, 2026
explanations: Hemophilia A, hereditary factor VIII deficiency: D66 (HCC 111, the 'male' hemophilia HCC).
